extraction.Name: Ellen Running Hawk, nee Jarvis
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent to her allotment, as she did not want to pay taxes, but that she was told that she would have to take it any way, and pay taxes, so she accepted it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: traded her allotment of 332.71 acres to L. W. Dodenorf, of White Clay, Nebraska, for merchandise, to be taken out of his store as she needed it, this agreement being for $2000.00 dollars worth
extraction.Buyer: L. W. Dodenorf, of White Clay, Nebraska, for merchandise worth $2000.00; he said he would sell it when he could, and if he got more than $2000.00, he would pay her more; she was informed on good authority that he has never been able to sell it
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: did not want to pay taxes
extraction.Occupation/Income: supported by her husband, who farms for a living, besides some little lease money as an income
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent; health is very poor, having lately gone through an operation for appendicitis; husband's health is not good, having heart trouble; has one minor child to support, the child having good health; has never received any help from the County or Government; document number 6502; notation *3290* appears in document | TASK 5 BULK ALLOTMENT RECOVERY 2026-04-29: Sonnet text-extraction captured the allotment number from the source page header but classified it in NOTES as a 'document number' / 'Document No.' / 'No. NNNN' instead of placing it in the structured Allotment number field. The hypothesis that these document/file references are actually allotment numbers was confirmed via BLM cross-reference (exemplars: Eugene Means 2249, Lucy Patton 6802). This patch corrects 48 records via bulk regex extraction from NOTES with user-supervised review of every HIGH-confidence proposal. | Name-alternate note: BLM patent record uses surname 'Jarvis' (maiden name); the corpus name 'Ellen Running Hawk, nee Jarvis' captures both. Same pattern as Lorrain Midkiff Wellborn / Lorain Midkiff in Task 3.
